puma.p: [ pu + ma ] (pu) Google Translate (1) male uncle Men. (2) Image sex.

R:
pumā：ပုမာ （ပ）
ယောကျ်ား။
DOP: puma(n) puma , m. [ S. puṃs], ( sg. nom. pumā, pumo, pumaṃ; acc. pumaṃ; instr. pumunā; gen. pumassa, poso (?); loc. pume; pl. nom. pumā; see also Sadd 162, 14 foll.; iic puṃ 2 -, puṅ-, pum-), 1. a male; a man; a human being; Abh 227 (poso ~ā ca puriso); D II 273, 18* (itthī hutvā svajja ~o ’mhi devo); Ja II 52, 6* (yadā parābhavo hoti poso jīvitasaṅkhaye atha jālaṃ ca pāsaṃ ca āsajjā pi na bujjhati, sg. gen. ? cf 52, 8´ : ~o ti satto; see also K.R. Norman, 1985, pp. 26–29 ) = III 331, 8* = IV 425, 27* ; III 459, 13* (na ~ā jāyare kule; 459, 18´ : puttā na jāyantī ti attho); V 154, 10* (~aṃ gatā; 154, 14´ : purisaṃ upasaṅkantā samānā); VI 80, 9* (na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ labbhā hi ~unā idaṃ; 80, 25´ : ~unā ti purisena); 238, 21* (n’ ev’ itthī na ~ā āsiṃ manussatte sudullabhe; 239, 13´ : napuṃsakattaṃ sandhāy’ āha); 239, 2* (~ā devo bhavissāmi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pumadevo); Ap 42, 11 (yathā balākayonimhi na vijjati ~ā sadā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ~o); Cp 3:6:2 (soḷasitthisahassānaṃ na vijjati ~o tadā; Cp-a 216, 5 foll.: putto na labbhati, na kevalaṃ ca putto eva dhītā pi ’ssa natthi eva); Dhātuk 50, 5* (dhammadhātu itthī ~aṃ); Vism 513, 3* (atthi nibbuti na nibbuto ~ā); Ap-a 281, 28 (~e avijjamāne); Sadd 153, 9 (attā ātumā sā ~ā); 657, 27 foll.; — 2. ( gr.t.t. ) the masculine gender; Sadd 31, 28 (pum-itthiliṅgavasena); 64, 30* (poso sarīrī ti ~e bhūtam iti napuṃsake pajā ti itthiyaṃ vutto); 153, 4* (pum-itthīsu pavattito); — ifc see itthi-; — pun - napuṃsakaliṅga , mfn. , in the masculine and neuter gender; Sadd 85, 17* (~o ca bhūtasaddo pavattati); — puma - tta , n. , the masculine gender; Abh 910 (liṅgam … ~’-ādimhi); — pum - bahutta , n. , the masculine plural; Abh 184 (~e kurū sakkā); — pum - bhāva , m. , the state of being a man; Sadd 67, 27 (pumassa bhāvo ~o); — pul - liṅga , n. and mfn. [ S. puṃliṅga], a word in the masculine gender; (being in) the masculine gender; Th-a I 5, 13 (sīhānaṃ … ~-vasena āgatānaṃ); Paṭis-a 453, 10 ; Sadd 36, 27 (purisassa vācakaṃ ~aṃ bhummavacanan ti); 61, 10 foll. (bhūto … natthibhāvo ti okārantaṃ ~aṃ …); 516, 21 (kārakasaddo … ~o pi hoti); — pulliṅgāni in Ee at Ja V 143, 22* is wr for phuliṅgāni ( Be, Ce so ); — apuma , m. , not the masculine gender (ie feminine or neuter); Abh 12; 57; 429 (anupubby apume kamo); — see also puṅkokila, puṅgava, napuṃsaka.

puṃ.p: [ (1) yādicchakanāma. (2) puma-mha proṅaḥlāsopuda. (nirutti.389.moga,1.56. ) ] (pu) Google Translate (1) Hell. (2) offspring. (3) male, uncle, male. (4) Primary. (5) Nirvana.

P: Puṁ，as a term for Purgatory （niraya）：see Bdhgh’s etym．of puggala Vism．310，as quoted under puggala．（Page 462）
R:
puṃ：ပုံ （ပ）
ငရဲ။ ယောကျ်ား။
DOP: 1 puṃ n. (?) [?], 1. hell; Vism 310, 25 (pun ti vuccati nirayo tasmiṃ galantī ti puggalā) ≠ Nidd-a I 26, 9 (puṃ vuccati nirayo …); Nidd-a I 258, 2 (puṃ tāyati rakkhatī ti putto, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se puttayati rakkhatī ti); Paṭis-a 85, 17 (puṃsaṅkhāte niraye risati hiṃsatī ti puriso) ≠ Sadd 453, 14 ; — 2. a body; Paṭis-a 442, 5 (lokiyavohārena hi puṃ vuccati sarīraṃ, tasmiṃ pusmiṃ reseti pavattatī ti puriso, Ee so, but prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se puri … purismiṃ seti …); Sadd 506, 8 (tanū vapu sarīraṃ puṃ kāyo deho ti ādayo sarīravācakā saddā).
